author: mr_pilot
body:
Hello, my name is mr_pilot and I would like to apply for moderator rank!

Age: 16
Timezone: UTC - 8:00
I have Teamspeak.
I have Discord.
I have access to recording software.

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers?

 Yes, I was an admin in a server called gtcomplay which died a year ago. My job there was to create plugins, and enforce the rules.


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? 

My biggest weakness is when other players try to get me angry at them, so most of the time I try to ignore them, but if I will be moderator and they will continue trying to annoy I will automatically mute / kick them (if I am allowed to).


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not? 

I think a leader must be a responsible and honest, who isn't afraid to do stuff even if they seem hard / impossible; He need to help others and not just himself; He need to make other people trust him and follow him, otherwise he can't be a leader when nobody trusts him... I consider myself a leader because whenever I can I try to help my friends or people I don't know, I am always responsible for my action and I don't lie about something when I do it. If I do something I always think about the consequences of it before I do it.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

I think that most of the players I know are not so responsible for what they do, they just do something and then they regret it or try to fight everyone about what they have done. Also, I have more than 6 years of programming skills, especially with Java.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

I believe I should have good communicating skills because the only way to make someone trust you or like you is by talking to him. I believe I have good communicating skills.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

I believe a moderator must be:
- Patient - because not every other player will be nice to him just as he tries to be nice to them.
- Have some basic programming skills - assume that some minigame or plugin starts crashing or behaving abnormal. What should you do?
- A leader - as you asked me to write in the previous question, a moderator should be responsible for what he does and make other people trust him and follow him.

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? I should contact other staff members and admins and tell them that about this moderator's behavior and that they should start taking actions against him.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? I believe that if this is allowed in the nightclub channel then I don't have a good reason to kick them from the conversation, but I should tell them that what they are doing is wrong and that they should not be talking like that on another staff member or any other player behind his back (even if I don't like him myself), and I should not cooperate with them in their disrespectful conversation. But if I see that somebody else joins the conversation and that that guy has nothing to do with the conversation and the other players continue swearing / being racial, I should kick them from the conversation in order to protect the other guy from what he might hear or from joining the disrespectful conversation.



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I should inform other staff / admins about that staff member leaking staff material, even if he is my friend, because normal players should not be seeing any staff material that is especially designed so that only staff members can see them, even if it is not that important.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do? I should tell them that other players are feeling angry and that they should stop or calm down a bit, and if there are higher level staff (like admins) I should talk to them about the situation when those senior staff members are using their permissions that way, even if that is a joke, because staff members need to be responsible and act like matures, and not joke around like kids.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator? I feel like this server has some good potential and I feel sad that there are not many players playing in it, so I want to help to make it better so much more players can join this server.


What does Avicus mean to you? Avicus is the only server I play right now, and I love this server, because I missed all of the pvp and minigames that other minecraft servers that died (such as oc.tc) have made, and this server contains similar things to the minigames I so loved. The staff members here are very nice and it is fun to play with them and with other players, and I want others to feel the same way about this server!


Anything specific the staff team could do better? They are awesome the way they are, but I believe they need to be a bit more active.


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus? I chose to play here because I was looking for minecraft PvP minigames, and then I found this server on a list of pvp servers, so I thought to myself "hey I should try this one", and I joined here and saw all of the minigames that the server has to offer and I really thought that this server is very good for me.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?

I only want to say that I really hope I get picked to be a staff member (junior mod in that case) and I hope I can contribute to the server!

[Denied] - I am sorry to say your application has been denied for:

- Does not meet criteria, 3 days of playtime.

You may not submit another application. Unless you manage to get enough playtime (3 days) before applications close, feel free to make another one. Thanks for applying!
